release_notes: Adds named pairing profiles so one Hermes host can pair and call additional phones (pair.py/call.py/voice_connector.py --profile, per-profile connector services), plus a documented user-approved daily family check-in recipe with summaries reported back through ask_hermes. Expands scope: the agent can now place calls to more than one paired phone; each additional phone still requires its own physical pairing code and an explicit user-approved schedule.
